title: The Longsword's chain, first person

frames.caption: At rest.
frames.alt: The Longsword held at rest at the right of the view

frames.caption: Second strike, mid-cut. The pale wedge is the blade's ribbon.
frames.alt: The blade rising across the lower view with a pale ribbon behind it

frames.caption: The hit. The game freezes here for 45 ms.
frames.alt: The blade stopped on the husk, which has turned red

frames.caption: Later in the same freeze. The weapon holds its pose and nothing on it answers the hit.
frames.alt: The same pose a moment later

frames.caption: After the cut, stopped at the right.
frames.alt: The blade held at the right edge after the cut

frames.caption: Two and a half ticks later, the same place. In the film's numbers it has crept under a centimetre.
frames.alt: The blade in the same place later

frames.caption: Third strike raised, the arm up to the grip.
frames.alt: The blade raised high with the forearm in view

frames.caption: Third strike frozen on the hit.
frames.alt: The blade down across the husk inside a bright ribbon

note: The second and third strikes of the chain against a husk that can't move. Pictures are a quarter of a tick apart.

frames.caption: Charged and held in view, as the 9 Nov round set it.
frames.alt: The Longsword raised high and held

frames.caption: Loosed at full charge: the blow frozen on the hit, its ribbon gold.
frames.alt: The blade across the husk with a gold ribbon

title: The guard

frames.caption: The guard up.
frames.alt: The Longsword laid across the view in guard

frames.caption: The next picture, half a tick later: already at rest.
frames.alt: The Longsword back at rest

note: In the film's frame data the guard rises over two ticks and is back at rest one frame after the key comes up, on both weapons.

title: Changing weapon

frames.caption: Longsword in hand.
frames.alt: The Longsword at rest

frames.caption: Four ticks after the change: nothing on screen.
frames.alt: An empty view with the husk

frames.caption: Nine ticks after: still nothing.
frames.alt: An empty view with the husk

frames.caption: Thirteen ticks after: the Katana comes up.
frames.alt: A blade coming up from the bottom right

note: Longsword to Katana. Vanilla raises the new weapon only as its attack cooldown refills, 13 ticks for the Katana.

frames.caption: At rest.
frames.alt: The Maul held with its head up

frames.caption: Raised overhead. The arms fill the corner.
frames.alt: The Maul raised with both arms in view

frames.caption: Frozen on the hit.
frames.alt: The Maul brought down beside the husk

frames.caption: After. The husk is thrown and the number shows.
frames.alt: The husk red and leaning with a damage number

title: From the side, as others see it

frames.caption: Raised for the first strike.
frames.alt: The fighter with the sword raised, seen from the side

frames.caption: The third strike on the husk.
frames.alt: The sword low across the husk

note: Poses only. On the slow runner the body's clip trails the hands, so timing can't be read from this take.
